message.content:
**Description of the top strip:**

Yes, there is a decorative banner: a blue ornamental band across the very top, followed by a repeating geometric lace/zigzag pattern strip in blue. Below it sits a large green rounded banner with a blue circular medallion overlapping its right end, encircled by an open blue ring.

**1) Small word above/left of the medallion:**
The word is **الدرس**, letter by letter: ا ل د ر س
(it sits just above the medallion, in small blue script).

**2) Digit inside the medallion:**
**11** — digit by digit: 1, 1 (white numerals on a blue circle).

**3) Main title inside the green banner (in blue Arabic script):**
**أحكام الطواف (2)**

**Rubric (green pill, right side, blue text, with a blue dot bullet):**
**أهداف الدرس**

**Numbered objectives (reading order):**

1- أن أتعرف حكم طواف القصم والوداع.
*(note: the second word appears as «أتعرف» and the text reads «حكم» — likely intended «حكمَ»; the word القصم is probably a misprint/scan of القصر)*

2- أن أتعرف أحكام طواف الحاضض.

**French notes:**
- «الدرس» = "la leçon"; the medallion shows lesson number 11.
- The parenthesized (2) in the title indicates this is part 2 of the lesson "Les règles du tawaf".
- No hadith quotes or [الموطأ رقم: NNN] references appear on this page; no illegible text requiring [؟].
